اعلوطتن (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتُنَّ (iʕlawwaṭtunna) /iʕ.law.watˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطْتُنَّ (uʕluwwiṭtunna) /uʕ.luw.witˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
